# 载荷强度与寿命

_Loads, Strength & Life_

结构评价需要把离心载荷、热载荷等作用，与材料和几何条件联系起来。寿命讨论还要说明载荷历程、损伤机理和证据范围。

_Structural assessment connects centrifugal and thermal loads to materials and geometry. A life assessment must also state the load history, damage mechanisms and scope of supporting evidence._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先列载荷和边界条件，再理解应力与变形结果。

_Specify loads and boundary conditions before interpreting stress and deformation._

- 区分疲劳、蠕变和氧化等不同损伤问题，不用单一指标替代全部寿命判断。

_Distinguish fatigue, creep and oxidation instead of treating one metric as a complete life assessment._

- 把试验、计算和使用记录建立对应关系，保留模型假设与版本。

_Link tests, calculations and service records while retaining model assumptions and revisions._
